name: Riello UPS
verdict: Founder-led Riello Elettronica group (Pierantonio Riello, since 1986). Nothing found.
note: Official Sponsor of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to riello-ups.com, stands under 'Official Sponsors' with the line 'Power Supply' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). The partnership is also described on Riello UPS's own page (riello-ups.com). Rating note (2026-09-30): Riello UPS is the brand of the Riello Elettronica group, founded in 1986 and led since by Pierantonio Riello (riello-elettronica-ownership). Its share register isn't public; no source names a state or state-fund shareholder, and no human-rights finding against the company was found.
